review: Every source and completed output viewed full size and in native label crops. No reruns, enlargement, retouching or text repair.

seedream5pro.reason: Best packaging fidelity: black pattern, leaf emblem and handwritten brand line closest to source; attractive realistic studio product finish. Tiny seal lettering and handwriting are redrawn and need final brand approval.

nano-banana-2-1.reason: Readable main English/French copy and attractive finish; black label pattern becomes gold and leaf seal is redesigned.

nano-banana-2-0.reason: Readable main copy; pattern becomes bronze/gold and seal changes to geometric ornament.

sunburst.reason: Attractive packshot with readable main copy and black pattern; handwritten brand line omitted and seal redesigned.
